_doc: Labeled corpus for the program-name extraction smoke test (scripts/name_smoke.py). 'noise' = strings that must be rejected as NOT a program name (nav labels, container headings, entry-requirement sentences). 'valid' = real program titles that must survive. Extend these lists whenever a new false-positive or false-negative is observed in a crawl — the smoke test turns each observation into a permanent regression guard.
